quests.title: The Culling of the Worms: Presentation

dialogue.t: Sure enough, the charging unit is running more smoothly... As you said, the elemental environment in this area is returning to normal.
...The activity of affected Wenut will calm down after some time, too.
Yeah, yeah... Thanks to your precious Wenutslayer Cannon, we can report back our success and go home.
It's OUR precious Wenutslayer Cannon, Shriya. I never forgot that this assignment was a joint effort.
...We definitely had our share of disagreements, but without you, the cannon wouldn't have been a success.
What's... gotten into you? Is this about wanting me to put in a good word for you in my report?
Well, I just suddenly feel that what we went through just now is quite similar to our experience from that other year: it wasn't always smooth sailing, but we still made it in the end.
And let's face it. In the end, your solution proved more efficient.
I... uh... I can't take all the credit...
...Because you were onto something, too. If you hadn't tested the Wenutslayer Cannon, I wouldn't have obtained the necessary data...
"To fix a machine you may only need to replace one gear, but the true challenge is finding that gear..." These words from my mentor are beginning to make sense to me.
I'm so glad you're here, Shriya.
Uh... I'm glad you're here, too...
Huh? The atmosphere between these two became so different all of a sudden...
Ahem! When we were cooperating on our graduation project, our relationship was rather rocky because we weren't very mature.
Yeah. Looking back on it, it wasn't anything too serious...
Well... How about meeting at the café for a drink next time? We could discuss how to write the report.

quests.description: Based on Shriya’s reasoning, you have successfully found where the root of the problem is…
